comments.name: Anita Sharma
comments.text:
Beautiful explanation of Navratri. I especially liked the reminder that the vrat is about devotion and self-discipline, not only food restrictions.

Could you also add a short section on a simple daily Durga prayer for families?

replies.name: HappyDiwali.org
replies.text: Thank you, Anita. Yes, we are adding a simple daily prayer section along with guidance for families who prefer a short home puja.

comments.name: Ravi Mehta
comments.text: The nine-day structure is very useful. It would be helpful to mention that customs and fasting foods can vary by family and region.

comments.name: Meera Iyer
comments.text: I came for the Navratri dates but stayed for the spiritual meaning. The focus on Shakti, seva and inner reflection makes the page much more meaningful.

replies.name: HappyDiwali.org
replies.text: Thank you, Meera. That is exactly the balance we want—practical festival information together with the devotional meaning behind the observance.
